expected_performance.daily_volume_expected: 15-30 trades per day across all stations

daily_checks: Verify accuracy rate for the day (compared to threshold)
Check trading volume against expected norms
Review signal agreement rates (both_agree vs single_lane vs conflict)
Monitor confidence distribution and flag unusual values
early_warning_indicators: Accuracy falling below warning level for 3 days consecutively
Majority of trades coming from 'conflict' pattern (indicating misaligned signals)
Volume dropping below warning threshold for 2+ consecutive days
Calibration drift (confidences not matching actual win rate)
automated_alert_conditions: Total drawdown > 1.5% of capital in single day

immediate_rollback_triggers: Drawdown exceeding emergency limit (3% in one day)

rollback_process.step_2_verify_accuracy: Manually verify latest outcomes against predictions
rollback_process.step_3_revert_configuration: Switch back to last known stable config
rollback_process.step_4_investigate: Analyze logs to understand root cause
rollback_process.step_5_resume_decision: Decide whether to resume or remain paused after analysis

circuit_breaker_rules.daily_stop_loss: Stop trading if P&L < -2% of starting capital in single day
circuit_breaker_rules.cumulative_stop_loss: Stop trading if cum P&L < -5% over 7-day period
circuit_breaker_rules.consecutive_negative_days: Pause trading after 5 consecutive negative days
circuit_breaker_rules.loss_per_trade_limit: Abort single trade if realized loss exceeds 0.5% of capital

rollback_verification.accuracy_improve_after_rollback: Post-rollback accuracy should return to baseline within 3 days
rollback_verification.volume_normalization_check: Trading volume should return to normal range within 2 days
rollback_verification.profit_recovery_indicator: Rollback successful if positive daily performance resumes in 5 days

test_objectives: Validate sustained accuracy of fused system
Test robustness under changing market conditions
Ensure rollback procedures are understood and accessible
Gather sufficient data for full deployment decision

scheduled_reviews.3_day_manual: Manual system health check and configuration review
scheduled_reviews.weekly_analytical: Performance analysis and potential parameter adjustments
scheduled_reviews.at_rollbacks: Full system review and procedure update if rollback triggered

success_confirmation_process: Confirm accuracy holds over 3 different weeks
Verify all major alert pathways work correctly
Validate rollback procedures through at least 1 test trigger
Document lessons learned for permanent deployment

deployment_checklist: All Phase 11-13 components loaded and operational
Calibration parameters updated with latest results
